name: Feudum

categories.label: Veneration points on track (epoch scoring, guild/region/immediate VP, disloyalty penalties)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track (chấm epoch, VP tức thời, trừ phạt bất trung)
categories.hint: Running VP total on the score track before final scoring; already net of disloyalty penalties.

categories.label: Epic Voyage track sections
categories.hint: Per section: 0 = no disc, 1 = disc but not leading, 2 = leading or tied. Sections 1-3 score lower/higher value (3/5, 7/9, 11/13); section 4 scores 17 only if leading/tied (enter 0 or 2).

categories.label: Outposts, farms, towns ruled
categories.labelVi: Tiền đồn / nông trại / thị trấn đang cai trị

categories.label: Sets of 3 identical locations ruled
categories.hint: 3 VP per set; a feudum is wild and may match itself or another type.

categories.label: Royal Writs with king's seal
categories.labelVi: Royal Writ có dấu ấn vua
categories.hint: Total VP from charter Royal Writs that carry a king's seal at game end (values printed on the cards).

categories.label: Sulfur left in barrel (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Sulfur còn trong thùng (phân định hòa)

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: area-majority. Game ends when epoch 5 is triggered (a region tile stack empties); finish round, score epoch, then final scoring. VP gained during epochs are tracked on the VP track (vpTrack). Charter Royal Writ values vary per card (e.g. kingdom writs 3/5/7/9 per location ruled, isolated 5/11/17, 2-3 sulfur 5/7, monster 7); enter total from cards. Mandates are not scored at the end.
